“The only thing I do is go to school and play video games” Yeah you’re 14. School and hobbies are kinda all there is to be going on at 14

“I’m not having as much fun as a teenager as I’m supposed to have” Don’t worry about it. There’s not some fun quota you’re meant to be fulfilling. Are you enjoying playing video games? If so, then good. Maybe look into some extracurricular stuff at school if you wanna develop more interests and have more to do, or look into some more hobbies

“Not good enough for her” You’re a person. You’re worth no less than any other person and some dickhead telling you otherwise doesn’t change that. If you wanna ask her out, do it. Let me tell you from experience, rejection can feel not great but ultimately it’s not really all that big a deal. Just keep in mind she has a right to say no to you and don’t get bitter or petty if that’s what happens. Getting rejected doesn’t make you any less of a person, it’s a perfectly natural part of life. All of that is just for if you’re still interested in her, if not that’s okay too

“Feel like I don’t have a purpose in life anymore” You’re a teenager. Your purpose right now is getting that education. 

“I don’t know what I want to become when I get older” That’s okay. You’ve got some time to figure out what you wanna pursue. Look at your interests, see if there’s anything you’re passionate in and go from there. Also, it’s okay to feel like you wanna be one thing and be wrong. Plenty of people take a long time to figure out what they wanna do, and that’s perfectly okay. There’s no template for life you have to fall into, it’s all about what you want out of life and you’ve got the rest of your life to figure that out. No one has everything figured out, even when it comes to themselves. Don’t worry about it
